item.title: "Strong Response" from Chung Cheong-rae, Kim Eo-jun Backs Down... Putting Out the 'Prosecution Withdrawal Deal Theory' Fire (“강력대응” 정청래, 발빼는 김어준... ‘공소취소 거래설’ 불끄기)
item.description:
<<>> ()

On the 12th, Democratic Party of Korea leader Chung Cheong-rae stated regarding the so-called 'deal theory'—allegations of a trade between the withdrawal of President Lee Jae-myung's prosecution and prosecutorial supplementary investigation rights recently raised on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube—that "the party will respond strongly using all possible means." On the same day, Kim also backed down on his YouTube channel, saying, "(Justice Minister) Jeong Sung-ho said (the deal theory) is not true, and President Lee is absolutely not the kind of person who would propose such a deal in the first place." As the controversy grew, the Democratic Party leadership and Kim moved to contain the situation three days after the deal theory was raised. ()

At a party meeting in the National Assembly that day, Leader Chung said, "The groundless prosecution withdrawal deal theory is rampant out of nowhere," adding, "Such a thing is unimaginable in the Lee Jae-myung administration." He continued, "It's something that cannot exist, should not exist, and in fact, does not exist." Floor Leader Han Byung-do also said, "Think about how long the President has suffered because of the prosecution," and questioned, "What kind of deal could he possibly have made with such a prosecution? Regardless of the details, does that make any logical sense?" He stated, "The party will respond very actively and decisively." (더불어민주당 정청래 대표가 12일 최근 김어준씨 유튜브에서 제기된 이른바 ‘이재명 대통령 사건의 공소취소와 검찰의 보완수사권 거래설’에 대해 “당에서 가능한 모든 방법을 동원해 강력 대응하겠다”고 밝혔다. 김씨도 이날 유튜브에서 “(정성호) 법무부 장관이 (거래설을) 아니라고 했고, 애초 이 대통령은 그런 딜을 제안할 사람이 절대 아니다”라며 발을 뺐다. 파문이 커지자 민주당 지도부와 김씨가 거래설이 제기된 지 사흘 만에 수습에 나선 것이다.)

On his YouTube channel, Kim also dismissed the deal theory, saying, "One of the reasons President Lee survived countless prosecutorial operations since his time as Seongnam mayor and became president is precisely because there were no such shady deals." He added, "However, if someone sold the President's name like that, it would be extremely dangerous," and noted, "The Justice Minister said it's completely groundless, and if so, that's truly fortunate." He further predicted, "This issue (the deal theory) likely won't progress any further." He also dismissed suggestions that the deal theory was pre-arranged to appear on YouTube, saying, "How could that be possible?" (정 대표는 이날 국회 의원총회에서 “뜬금없이 공소취소 거래설이 난무한다”면서 “이재명 정부에서 이런 일은 상상할 수 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 “있을 수도 없는 일이지만, 있어서도 안 되는 일이고 실제로 있는 일도 아니다”라고 했다. 한병도 원내대표도 “대통령께서 얼마나 긴 시간 동안 검찰 때문에 시달려 왔나”라며 “이런 검찰하고 도대체 무슨 거래를 했다는 건지 내용을 떠나 상식적으로 납득이 되나”라고 말했다. 그는 “당 차원에서 아주 적극적이고 단호하게 대응하겠다”고 말했다.)

Previously, on the 10th, a guest on Kim's YouTube channel claimed, "It is a fact that a high-ranking government official, clearly a top aide to President Lee, very recently conveyed the message 'My words are the President's will' and 'withdraw the prosecution' to multiple high-ranking prosecutors." The guest added, "The prosecution would think, 'The Lee Jae-myung administration wants to make a deal with us.'" Upon hearing this, Kim commented, "That's a major scoop." On the 11th, another guest stated, "If the deal theory is true, it would be grounds for impeaching the president." (김씨도 유튜브에서 “이 대통령이 성남시장 시절부터 그 무수한 검찰의 작업에도 끝까지 살아남아 대통령이 된 이유 중 하나는 그런 검은 거래가 없었기 때문”이라며 거래설을 일축했다. 이어 “그런데 누군가 대통령 이름을 그렇게 팔았다면 그건 굉장히 위험한 것”이라며 “법무부 장관은 완전한 사실무근이라는 것이고, 그렇다면 정말 다행”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이 사안(거래설)은 이 이상 진도를 나가지 못할 것 같다”고 했다. 그는 또 거래설이 사전에 조율돼 유튜브에 나온 것 아니냐는 지적에 대해서도 “그럴 리가 있느냐”며 일축했다.)

Subsequently, Justice Minister Jeong Sung-ho strongly denied the deal theory as an "absurd conspiracy theory," and pro-Lee lawmakers called it "nothing more than a rumor at the level of gossip" and "a distortion not even worthy of a third-rate novel." As criticism poured in, it appears that Party Leader Chung Cheong-rae, who is close to Kim, also coordinated with the presidential office and the government to order a strong party-level response. Meanwhile, as scheduled, the Democratic Party submitted a request for a parliamentary investigation to the National Assembly plenary session that day regarding the withdrawal of prosecutions for seven cases involving President Lee, including the Daejang-dong, Wirye New Town, and North Korea remittance cases. The Democratic Party's position is that if the truth behind the suspicions of fabricated indictments is revealed through the parliamentary investigation and a special prosecutor, the prosecution should withdraw the cases. (앞서 지난 10일 김씨 유튜브에 나온 한 출연자는 “누가 봐도 이 대통령의 최측근인 정부 고위 관계자가 매우 최근 다수 고위 검사들에게 ‘내 말이 곧 대통령의 뜻이다’ 라면서 ‘공소 취소해 줘라’라는 뜻을 전달했다. 여기까지는 팩트”라고 했다. 그러면서 “검찰은 ‘이재명 정부가 우리랑 거래하고 싶어 하는구나’라고 생각할 것”이라고 했다. 이를 들은 김씨는 “큰 취재를 했다”고 했다. 11일엔 다른 출연자가 “거래설이 사실이면 대통령 탄핵 사유”라고도 했다.)

Although the Democratic Party announced a strong response to the 'deal theory,' the underlying conflict between the government and hardliners within the party over prosecutorial reform is expected to continue. The Democratic Party has already set as party policy the government-proposed bills for the Serious Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Service, aiming for National Assembly passage within this month. (이후 정성호 장관은 “황당한 음모론”이라며 거래설을 강하게 부인했고, 친명 의원들은 “지라시 수준의 소문에 불과한 주장” “삼류 소설도 안 되는 왜곡”이라고 했다. 비판이 쏟아지자 김씨와 막역한 사이인 정청래 대표도 청와대와 정부 측과 보조를 맞춰 당 차원의 강력 대응을 지시한 것으로 보인다. 그러면서 민주당은 이날 예정대로 이 대통령의 대장동·위례신도시·대북송금 사건 등 7개 사건의 공소 취소를 위한 국정조사 요구서를 국회 본회의에 보고했다. 민주당은 국정조사와 특검을 통해 조작 기소 의혹의 실체가 드러나면 검찰이 사건을 공소 취소해야 한다는 입장이다.)

However, hardliners within the party, such as lawmakers Choo Mi-ae and Kim Yong-min, who are members of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, are demanding significant revisions, arguing the government bills are insufficient. Notably, they are calling for the complete abolition of the supplementary investigation right, which President Lee had previously stated was necessary on multiple occasions. Lawmakers Choo and Kim again emphasized at the committee meeting that day that the government bills can be amended. Lawmaker Kim's stance is that all current prosecutors at the Supreme Prosecutors' Office should be dismissed and re-hired as Public Prosecution Service prosecutors after a review. They are also advocating for the abolition of the title 'Prosecutor General,' which the President wanted to retain. (민주당이 ‘거래설’에 강력 대응 방침을 밝혔지만, 사태의 본질인 검찰 개편을 둘러싼 정부와 민주당 강경파의 갈등은 계속될 것으로 보인다. 민주당은 정부가 만든 중수청(중대범죄수사청), 공소청 법안을 당론으로 정한 바 있고 이달 내 국회 처리를 목표로 하고 있다.)

Amid this, it is known that Leader Chung Cheong-rae is considering amending the government bills to partially reflect the hardliners' demands. A Democratic Party official said, "Leader Chung has formed considerable consensus with the hardliners on the need to abolish the title Prosecutor General," adding, "He also holds the view that a proviso clause should be added to ensure there is no possibility of Public Prosecution Service prosecutors being granted investigation rights. Furthermore, he believes the clause regarding the transfer of prosecutors' duties, which allows investigation cases or prosecutors to be arbitrarily moved to other district prosecutor's offices, should also be partially revised."
